fieldNotes.truckGate: Controlled fenced entry. Perimeter chain-link fence runs continuously along Interstate Drive; the truck driveway enters through a single gap in the fence at ~28.0733, -81.9819. Web listings note visitors must show a driver's license at the gate for a parking pass - corroborates a manned/controlled gate.
fieldNotes.guardShack: A small ~1-vehicle-footprint structure sits on the east side of the driveway opening at the property line - a gatehouse/guard booth. A second small structure visible in the dock-apron imagery near the entry.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False - guard shack present, so not a remote/kiosk check-in.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Large paved apron inside the gate before the dock bank can hold queued trucks; medium confidence.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Long approach from the Interstate Drive gate across a deep paved apron to the south-face dock bank - room for 3+ trucks.
fieldNotes.entryExitTogether: Single controlled truck gate off Interstate Drive serving both inbound and outbound.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Long dock bank along the south face with ~15-24 trailers backed in and many more empty dock positions; estimated ~40-50 doors total - band 25-50.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Trailers parked without tractors in the NW-side drop yard and along the building's north/west edge; band 25-50.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Dedicated trailer-storage area at the NW corner of the property.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Lakeland FL - industrial corridor flanking I-4 with adjacent large warehouses, an electrical substation, and nearby residential; classified Urban.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~38 acres from perimeter box (~365m N-S x ~540m E-W).
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property.
fieldNotes.status: Yelp marks the retail/outlet listing as CLOSED, but 2026 Maxar satellite imagery shows an active operation - trailers backed into docks, process equipment running. Audited as an operating facility.
